correctness.rationale: Two standalone complete finite certificates compute all claims over two irreducible cubic presentations of GF343: direct enumeration of all 117649 affine pairs and 117993 normalized lines; separate parametrization-plus-21-nodes enumeration and independent exhaustive 66430 point-pair line reconstruction. Both give 365 curve points, the seven exact line frequencies, the 336 eight-secants, concurrence multiplicities 0/1/2/8 with counts 51633/19152/46872/336, and 51604 exterior holes. Four exact incidence double-count identities are asserted. Both included scripts were executed from their paths and emitted *_VERIFY_OK, and the source establishes octic irreducibility. The result is finite only, with no unsupported infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The original 2022 BKS work supplies geometry, parametrization, and nodes, and the 2023 Korchmaros–Nagy–Szonyi paper supplies general secant-character restrictions, broad completeness theorems outside the exponent-three case and partial on-curve statements. Neither inspected source states or implies the 117993-line spectrum, 117993-point eight-secant multiplicity spectrum, or the exact 51604 uncovered exterior points at q=7,r=3. A smaller-field q=5 BKS sextic census is not a statement about the distinct q=7 octic. An unindexed computational table is a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed or less discoverable prior finite BKS q=7 octic census or projective-code weight table may exist.
The count of eight-secants and which curve points are covered may follow from prior geometry; only complete line and offcurve incidence spectra are claimed as new.

value.rationale: The original source family is a natural rational BKS plane octic; published work specifically leaves extension exponent three outside its broad completeness theorem. For q=7 the complete 117993-line section spectrum and complete eight-secant concurrence spectrum determine a new exact natural invariant, 51604 uncovered exterior points, and prove incomplete arc structure. This is nontrivial full finite geometry, not a cosmetic rescaling of earlier q5 data: different curve degree and field, plus exact external double-concurrency constraints, and meaningful projective-code interpretation. Results at other field sizes and a general exponent-three classification remain unproved.
